_comment: Dimension 3 (outputs_produced) evidence manifest. For every required_outputs entry of every flow step: where a real run produced it, at what path, and at what size in bytes. Measured 2026-07-27 on the campaign host. HISTORY + REPRODUCIBILITY RECORD - the test re-verifies every claim live against whichever run root is present.
_admissibility: A run root counts as a real flow run only if it carries provenance.jsonl or reports/orchestrator/. Agent scratch trees with hand-seeded artefacts (e.g. a GDS written by a throwaway mkgds.py) are excluded: counting a seeded input as a produced output is exactly the false-pass this campaign exists to remove.

benchmark-data/ic/caravel_user_project/v.note: carries phase2/stage2/dft/* that step 11 declares; tracked at HEAD

benchmark-data/evaluation/phase1_parity/.note: carries phase3/stage3/sim_postlayout/pass.flag that step 29 declares; tracked at HEAD

phase1/extraction_patterns.json.note: added with the vibe-ic#1348 declaration of this entry in D1's required_outputs; measured 2026-08-15, not on the 2026-07-27 sweep the rest of this file records. It resolves live in 9 of the 10 admissible run roots, so no verdict here rests on the recorded size.

reports/phase3/sta/pre_pnr_summary.json.base_run_note: RE-MEASURED 2026-08-10, not renamed. Commit 51517e71 retired benchmark-data/ic/spm/v1.5.66_gf180mcuD and bulk-renamed all 65 run/base_run citations onto the replacement cell. That is correct for a PRODUCED_BY_RUN `run`; it INVERTS a PRODUCED_LIVE `base_run`, because the replacement cell carries this artefact TRACKED AT HEAD (885 B, added by that same commit) while the retired one did not - verified with `git ls-tree -r 51517e71^ -- <retired cell>`, which lists post_route_signoff_corner.json, spef_vs_estimate_discrepancy.json and sta_corner_record_completeness.json under reports/phase3/sta/ and no pre_pnr_summary.json. A live production cannot be proved against a tree that already holds the artefact, so the record had become unprovable by construction and the cell was red. It is re-pointed at the run root step 10's OTHER declared output is already evidenced by, so both of this steps entries now come from ONE run: the run that produced phase3/stage3/sta/pre_pnr_timing.rpt is the run whose summary of that report is produced here. THE OLD RECORD WAS ALREADY HOLLOW, which is why this is not a like-for-like re-point: 969 B is exactly what this producer writes into a tree carrying NO STA report at all (passed:false, findings [STA_REPORT_EXISTS, SCOPE_NOT_FOUND], files_found:0, BOTH --under scopes in scoped_under_missing), byte-identical from four independent admissible roots measured on this commit. produce_live now refuses a base run in which no declared --under scope exists, so that absence record can never again be counted as a produced artefact.

Re-measured live: the artefact is tracked at HEAD in this root, non-empty and non-symlink, and the run's OWN write ledger (reports/write_ledger.json captured 2026-08-08T02:48:29Z) records step 11 as having written exactly this path. That is a provenance any checkout can re-derive; the old one was a claim about one machine.

reports/phase3/perc_sweep.json.provenance_note: declared 2026-08-28 to close the dimension-7 finding W1:gate_output_read_elsewhere on step 31 — `perc_corpus_sweep --report` writes it and the `sweep_reach_check --report` clause directly below it is the only reader, so it is load-bearing outside its own writer. UNPROVEN and not PRODUCED_BY_RUN because no run root this module may consult carries the path: `find -name perc_sweep.json` over the published corpus, 2026-08-28, returned nothing across all 10 admissible run roots, and the sweep clause that writes it was re-homed onto step 31 on 2026-08-25 — after every published cell. Same class as magic_illegal_overlap.json above, and the same consequence: the UNPROVEN branch re-searches every admissible root on each call, so the first run tree that publishes the file closes this entry live and the record reddens in the other direction.

reports/phase3/drc_signoff.json.provenance_note: the recorded copy is `eda_report_audit:drc` output (step 31's own gate clause `drc_report_check . --mode drc --signoff --under reports/phase3/drc_signoff.rpt --json reports/phase3/drc_signoff.json`) — same class as lvs.json and erc_density.json above. DECLARED by d976999c4 [v1.11.45], which added the path to step 31's required_outputs and did not measure it into this manifest; the parity gate has read 164 declared paths against 163 entries ever since. RE-DERIVED on the current tree rather than by widening that assertion: the artefact resolves non-empty at the run root five of its own siblings already cite, and the entry is decided LIVE by the same PRODUCED_BY_RUN branch as the other 121, so it reddens the day the root stops carrying it. ADMISSIBILITY of that run root, measured 2026-08-22 and recorded here because it is the second half of the same fact: the root carries both `provenance.jsonl` and `reports/orchestrator/` and so is admissible under this manifest's own criterion, and not every run root produces the .json form (the flow's own note: 16 roots carry the .rpt, 3 carry the .json) — this entry records where one DID, which is what the manifest is for.
